doc: Scans a 13-entry table of {value, mask} pairs starting at D_800712FC; returns the value of the first entry whose mask has any bit set in common with the given flags argument, or 0 if none match.

globals.name: D_800712FC
globals.decl: struct { s32 value; s32 mask; } D_800712FC[13]; /* array of 13 (value,mask) pairs, 8 bytes each; only accessed via offset 0 (value) and offset 4 (mask) in this function */
